_comment: Packaging identity for the white-label build. brand.json holds the embedded brand (name/accent/feed/appId); this holds the MSIX identity + signing + hosting. 'publisher' MUST equal the subject of the code-signing cert used to sign this partner's build (in Cert:\CurrentUser\My) and stays constant for the life of the app. For this example it is CN=Nimbo Dev so it signs with the dev cert; a real partner uses their own (e.g. CN=Acme Hosting Ltd).
